# {{name}} {{version}}

The Cap'n Proto schema compiler as a WASI command (`wasm/capnp.wasm`), the
standard schemas (`include/`), and `bin/capnp-wasm`, a Bash launcher that runs
the compiler and separately built WASI language generators under Wasmtime
{{wasmtime}}. This archive contains no SDK code and no generator modules.
Built from [nullstyle/capnpc-wasm](https://github.com/nullstyle/capnpc-wasm) at commit
[`{{shortCommit}}`](https://github.com/nullstyle/capnpc-wasm/commit/{{commit}}) for the release
[`{{tag}}`](https://github.com/nullstyle/capnpc-wasm/releases/tag/{{tag}}).

## Verify the download

`SHA256SUMS` lists the archive, `{{stem}}.manifest.json`, and
`{{stem}}.spdx.json`, which are published next to it. Check them, compare the
archive digest with the row for this release in the repository's
[published releases table](https://github.com/nullstyle/capnpc-wasm/blob/{{commit}}/docs/releases.md#published-releases), and
verify the build provenance that the release workflow attested:

```sh
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
gh attestation verify {{stem}}.tgz --repo nullstyle/capnpc-wasm
```

After extraction, `package/manifest.json` is byte-identical to
`{{stem}}.manifest.json`, and `verify-release.ts` checks every packaged file
against it. In the download directory, run the verifier from a checkout of the
repository at the tag (`/path/to/capnpc-wasm` below); the copy inside the
package is the same program but shares the archive's trust:

```sh
tar -xzf {{stem}}.tgz
deno run --allow-read /path/to/capnpc-wasm/scripts/verify-release.ts --sums SHA256SUMS ./package
```

## Compile a schema

The launcher needs Wasmtime {{wasmtime}} (or a newer patch release of the same
series) on `PATH` or in `CAPNP_WASM_WASMTIME`. It runs the compiler against a
read-only copy of a workspace directory with memory and time bounds. With
`example.capnp` in the current directory:

```sh example
mkdir -p "$PWD/work/input/include" "$PWD/work/output"
cp -R package/include/. "$PWD/work/input/include/"
cp example.capnp "$PWD/work/input/"
package/bin/capnp-wasm compiler --workspace "$PWD/work/input" -- \
  compile --no-standard-import -I/include --src-prefix=/ -o- /example.capnp \
  > "$PWD/work/request.bin"
```

`request.bin` is a standard unpacked `CodeGeneratorRequest`. Feed it to a WASI
generator built against your own runtime pin; the output directory is written
only when the generator exits 0:

```sh
package/bin/capnp-wasm generator --module /path/to/capnpc-zig.wasm \
  --output "$PWD/work/output" -- < "$PWD/work/request.bin"
```

`package/bin/capnp-wasm --help` prints the complete contract: filesystem roots,
bounds and their environment overrides, and exit statuses.
`package/bin/capnp-wasm --version` prints this package's version and the
packaged Wasmtime version.

## Contents

| Path                                    | Contents                                                          |
| --------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `wasm/capnp.wasm`                       | The schema compiler (WASI Preview 1 command)                      |
| `include/`                              | The standard schemas, resolved through `-I/include`               |
| `bin/capnp-wasm`                        | The Wasmtime launcher                                             |
| `runtime/wasmtime-version`              | The Wasmtime version the launcher accepts                         |
| `manifest.json`, `verify-release.ts`    | Every file's length and SHA-256, and the verifier                 |
| `provenance/`                           | Source-file digests, `mise.toml`, and `mise.lock` of the producer |
| `LICENSE`, `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`     | Apache-2.0 for this project; component notices (`licenses/`)      |
